subject: Request for short promo credit + pilot timeline pause while connector investigation completes
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@packetwise.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Packetwise Engineering <eng@packetwise.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot - connector instability blocking onboarding, request for pause + promo credits

Hi Karthik,

Quick update from our side: after kicking off the Packetwise -> Redwood sandbox integration yesterday our engineers hit a recurring failure in the connector when payload size spikes (~1.2MB). The SDK team is looking into it but the work will take at least 7 business days due to a dependency on our schema migration.

Given that the pilot window is scheduled to finish in 10 days, we're worried we won't have enough time to generate meaningful evals and adoption signals. Would Redwood be willing to (1) pause the pilot timeline by 14 days and (2) provide a small promo credit (enough for ~200k tokens) so we can re-run tests when the connector is fixed?

I've attached a very short error snippet and the latest pilot scope. We really want to get this live with Redwood — this is a strategic integration for us — but we need a little runway.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Park
Head of Integrations, Packetwise
Lena.mobile: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: connector_error_snippet.txt (text), pilot-scope-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Lena Park <lena@packetwise.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot - connector instability blocking onboarding, request for pause + promo credits

Hi Lena — thanks for the prompt heads-up and for sending the logs and scope.

We're sorry to hear about the migration dependency — totally understand needing extra runway. We can do two things immediately:

- I can request a 14-calendar-day pilot pause on our side so your evaluation window isn't penalized.
- I'll request a discretionary promo of equivalent to ~200k tokens to allow you to re-run the tests once your SDK bump lands.

I'll need a quick sign-off from our pilot approvals owner (marissa) and confirmation from my side that the credit cadence and constraints look OK. Marissa / Soojin — can you review and advise on the promo amount and whether we can approve the pause as a one-off for Packetwise? If engineering needs triage help, happy to have Marissa loop in a solutions engineer.

Action items for Packetwise: can you share the target test date after your migration completes so we can schedule the paused window?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot - connector instability blocking onboarding, request for pause + promo credits

Karthik / Soojin — forwarding Packetwise's request. My read: this is a high-fit strategic pilot (Packetwise has marketplace traction) and 200k tokens is within our discretionary promo budget for early-stage pilots.

I propose: approve a 14-calendar-day pause and a 200k-token promo credit with these guardrails:
- Credit expires 60 days from issuance.
- Credit usable only for the Packetwise pilot project (non-transferable).
- We document the revised pilot end date in HubSpot and attach the new pilot scope.

If you both agree, I'll enter the credit in the billing system and post the notes to the HubSpot deal (PW-DEAL-1294).

Also, engineering offered a quick sync if Packetwise needs triage beyond logs — we can offer a 30-minute debugging session with a solutions engineer next week. Recommend we offer that as a value-add to keep momentum.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Lena Park <lena@packetwise.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot - connector instability blocking onboarding, request for pause + promo credits

Hi Lena — quick note to confirm: Redwood approves the 14-calendar-day pause and we'll issue a 200k-token promo credit.

Logistics / next steps:
- Credit will be issued to the Packetwise pilot account and will expire 60 days from issuance.
- We've updated the HubSpot deal PW-DEAL-1294 and attached the revised pilot scope. Link: https://hubspot.company/contacts/contacts/1294
- If helpful, Marissa can run a 30-minute debugging session next Tue/Wed — suggest Tue 10:00am PT; please confirm.

Lena — could you confirm the expected date your SDK migration finishes (approx) so we mark the pilot resume date? Once you confirm, we'll push the credit and update the timeline.

Appreciate the partnership — we'll do what we can to keep the proof-of-value window meaningful.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.mobile: +1 650 555 0198
